title: Seasonal Academic Lead in Discrete Mathematics & Algorithms
description: The University of Cambridge Computer Laboratory is seeking a Seasonal Academic Lead to instruct our summer intensive school. In this role, you will deliver advanced lectures on data structures, algorithms, discrete structures, and basic programming. You will also lead the student project lab, supervise graduate assistant tutors, and direct academic career development sessions.
requirements: Extensive academic teaching background as a University Assistant Professor, Lecturer, or Teaching Coordinator.
Deep knowledge in discrete mathematics, algorithms, data structures, and computer science education.
Proven leadership experience in managing student career programs or coordinating career development centers.
Excellent academic writing, presentation, and mentoring skills in English.
PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or closely related field.
benefits: Access to historic Cambridge library databases and computing labs
Premium college housing accommodations during the program
